entries.description: Educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center for women of all ages, races and backgrounds on 52 acres of farmland, hills and evergreens, with a visitor's house (Star House) without electricity. Women with dependent children welcome. Four lesbians live there; the group is inactive and hopes to revive.
entries.raw_text: WHO FARM INC 37010 SE Snuffin Rd, Estacada, OR 97023 (503)630-6728. Who farm is an educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center for womyn of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds. We have 52 acres of beautiful farmland, fields, hills, evergreens, a visitor's house in the magical woods called Star House. Our land is located approx 30 miles SE of Portland with a city bus (NO 31) running within 5 miles of the farm. Visitor s may stay max 2 weeks. We charge $4 per night's stay in Star House. Womyn with dependent children are welcome. Bring your own food. We have very rainy weather and lots of mud so sisters bring rain gear and goulashes! There's no electricity in Star House. We welcome: new members/residents. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 52 acres, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land, inactive group with hopes to revive (trying to get back on our feet).
entries.notes: Type: Retreat/Gathering Space because it is defined as 'an educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center' (educational center rule). Land: street address given, so copied to land_*; 'Our land is located approx 30 miles SE of Portland'. Accepted groups: 'womyn of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds' before 1986 means Lesbian women + Non-lesbian women; 'Womyn with dependent children are welcome' gives children, no gender stated, so Girl children + Boy children. Residents: '4 lesbians' with 'women living on the land' counted as 4 (printed '4'' read as 4). Focuses: Workshops/education from educational, job skill, rural skill center; Farming/self-sufficiency from rural skills/farm focus is weak but center teaches rural skills and has 'farm land'. Inactive group with hopes to revive.

entries.description: Non-profit educational community organization teaching rural skills to women and their children, with camping spaces and cabins for trade and rent on 60 acres of woods and farm land. Group rentals available, no violence. Women live and work on the land.
entries.raw_text: PENTHESILEIA, INC Box 97 Star Route 2, Seal Rock, OR 97376 (503)563-3643. Penthesileia, Inc is a non-profit educational community organization teaching rural skills to women and their children. A matrix between rural and urban. We have camping spaces and cabins for trade and rent. Group rentals available. No violence. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, leashed dogs, work exchanges. We have/are: 60 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: Retreat/Gathering Space because it is an educational organization that offers camping and cabins (educational center rule). Land: Star Route is a rural route, so mailing address copied to land_*. Accepted groups: Girl children and Boy children, and Non-lesbian women are named; Lesbian women added because the directory is for lesbians and the group welcomes new members. Focus: Workshops/education from 'teaching rural skills'. Residents blank: no count given.

entries.description: Land with food and flower gardens, orchards, woods and pasture, raising chickens, sheep and working ponies. Five lesbians live there and work jobs in town to pay for their home. Visits arranged in advance for a fee; no dogs.
entries.raw_text: RAINBOW'S END Rt 3 Box 3645, Roseburg, OR 97470 (503)673-7649. Our land embraces food and flower gardens, orchards, woods and pasture. We raise chickens, sheep and working ponies. We're paying for our home by working various jobs in town. Visitor policy: visits must be prearranged by mail or phone. Land use fee: $2-$4 per day, food: $4 per day. Sometimes, for specific projects, work exchange may be arranged. No dogs!!! We welcome: girl children, boy babies, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 5 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land, women working in town.
entries.notes: Type: Intentional Community/Cooperative: five lesbians living on the land (three or more), paying for their home. Land: rural route copied to land_*. Accepted groups: 'girl children' = Girl children; 'boy babies' = Boy children (babies only); 'nonlesbian women' named; Lesbian women because 5 lesbians live there. Residents: '5 lesbians' with 'women living and working on the land'. Focus: Farming/self-sufficiency from raising food gardens, orchards, chickens, sheep.

entries.description: A group of hard working women and 4 children living on land with housing, woods and farm land. Write or call first; no drop-ins. Welcomes new members and children.
entries.raw_text: GOLDENWIMMIN 3502 Coyote Creek Rd, Wolf Creek, OR 97497 (503)866-2520. We are a group of hard working wimmin and 4 children. Write or call first. Absolutely no drop ins. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children. We have/ are: 6 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on and working the land.
entries.notes: Type: Intentional Community/Cooperative: group of six lesbians and 4 children living on the land. Land: street/road address copied to land_*. Residents: 6 lesbians plus 4 children (members' children count) = 10. Accepted groups: girl and boy children named; Lesbian women because 6 lesbians live there and new members welcome; 'wimmin' not listed as a welcome statement so no non-lesbian women.

entries.description: Feminist retreat on 23 forested acres in southern Oregon with summer and winter sessions for 10-30 women: workshops, skillsharing, discussion groups, recreation and home-cooked meals. Main house and women-built cabins plus camping spots. Visitors contribute to food and a land support fund.
entries.raw_text: WOMANSHARE Box 681, Grants Pass, OR 97526 (503)862-2807. A feminist retreat on forested land in Southern OR. We plan summer and winter sessions for 10-30 women — workshops, skillsharing, discussion groups, recreation and home-cooked meals. We have a main house and several women-built cabins for sleeping and many secluded spots for camping. The main house has electricity, hot water and a shower. Visitors are asked to contribute $3/day for food and $1-3/day to our land support fund. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 5-10 lesbians, 23 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity (outdoor toilet), camping space, woods, farmland, women living/working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: Retreat/Gathering Space because it calls itself 'A feminist retreat'. Land: PO box so street/zip blank; land state OR from 'Southern OR'. Residents: range '5-10 lesbians' with women living on the land, smaller number 5 stored. Accepted groups: 'girl children' named; Lesbian women because lesbians live there. Focus: Workshops/education from 'workshops, skillsharing, discussion groups'.

entries.description: Single woman living on 16 acres of basically undeveloped land. Visitors welcome for 3-4 days in exchange for work; write ahead.
entries.raw_text: MULLEINSONG PO Box 302, Applegate, OR 97530. Single woman living on basically undeveloped land. Visitors welcome for 3-4 days in exchange for work. Please write ahead of time. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 1 lesbian, 16 acres, camping space, woods, women living on and working the land.
entries.notes: Type: Private/Individual Land: one woman lives there ('Single woman', '1 lesbian'); two-woman rule. Land: PO box, so street and zip blank; land state OR taken from the mailing state as land is presumably nearby (not stated). Residents 1: 'women living on and working the land'. Accepted groups: 'girl children'; Lesbian women because a lesbian lives there and visitors are welcome.

entries.description: Residential community with a community center where members can stay for limited visits; membership is $10-$20 a month. Two cottages available for 1-year lease. Welcomes new members/residents (cottages rented monthly), girl children, and non-lesbian women as non-resident members only. About 15 lesbians in a small community on the ocean.
entries.raw_text: THE PAGODA COMMUNITY 207 Coastal Hwy-LC, St Augustine, FL 32084 (904)824-2970. We are a residential community with a community center where members can stay for limited visits. Membership is $10-$20/mo. We currently have two cottages available for 1 year lease. We welcome: new members/residents (we rent cottages on a monthly basis only), girl children, nonlesbian women (as non-resident members only). We have/are: about 15 lesbians, small community on ocean, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Included as a listing, under the editor's note 'These groups don't have land, per se, but we wanted to include them for your information' (the note is not part of raw_text): a residential lesbian community on its own property, so a row per the codebook. Type: Intentional Community/Cooperative: 'We are a residential community'. Land: street address copied to land_*. Residents blank: 'about 15 lesbians' but the list does not say women live on the land. Accepted groups: Non-lesbian women only 'as non-resident members only'; Lesbian women implied by 15 lesbians; 'girl children' named.
